title: Purchase Price Drift for Repeat Essentials
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:order
| search repeat_essential=true unit_price=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(unit_price) as avg_unit_price by _time item_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks purchase price drift for repeat essentials over time and breaks it out by item.
value: Price drift on essentials is where quiet inflation hits the household most reliably.
implementation: Send purchase price drift for repeat essentials events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of purchase price drift for repeat essentials by item.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how purchase price drift for repeat essentials changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
